paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between average lagging (AL) and BLEU score for four different models. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL),” represents a linear scale ranging from a minimum value of 2 to a maximum value of 8, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” represents a linear scale ranging from a minimum value of 22 to a maximum value of 32, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 2. A solid blue line, marked with circle markers, represents the “Consistency-CE” model, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 26 at AL = 2 and increasing to approximately 30 at AL = 8. A dashed purple line, marked with diamond markers, represents the “Inconsistency-CE” model, beginning at a BLEU score of approximately 26 at AL = 2 and reaching approximately 29 at AL = 8. A solid black line, marked with square markers, represents the “Inconsistency-MP” model, displayed as approximately 23 at AL = 2 and increasing to approximately 27 at AL = 8. Finally, a solid red line, marked with star markers, represents the “Consistency-Bi” model, initiating at a BLEU score of approximately 26 at AL = 2 and ultimately reaching approximately 30 at AL = 8.
